races.paceDynamic: Bankatary will lead unopposed from the gates with Egyptian Pharaoh the only other confirmed early pace angle in this 13-runner field. The single front runner will dictate a steady, uncontested gallop over the extended 1m2f trip, creating a tactical race where the field bunches behind. This sets up perfectly for hold-up horses who can unleash late kicks, as the lack of pace pressure means stamina reserves will be crucial in the final 2f. The race shape strongly favours hold-up performers and patient rides over prominent racers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Bankatary gets an easy lead and maintains stamina reserves
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the leader to control fractions and kick clear when challenged. Class and tactical advantage prove decisive over a staying trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the modest pace allows closers to unleash finishing kicks
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses with stamina find their rhythm in the straight as early leaders tire. The patient tactics pay dividends in a war of attrition.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Bankatary goes too slow and the field sprint finishes
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble where any horse can win from any position. Prominent racers benefit from avoiding traffic problems.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Early Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Bankatary early despite style profiles
scenarios.body: Unexpected pace forces genuine stamina test and exposes horses without staying power. The race becomes truly run and rewards natural stayers.

races.paceDynamic: Durham Castle will likely lead from the start with no natural pace rivals to pressure him early, creating a sustainable gallop through the first half. The prominent racers like Shiplake, Uncle Don, Diligently and Alpha Magic will track closely behind but won't force the issue. With hold-up horses like Another Abbot, Righthere Rightnow and Indian Run needing the race to develop, Durham Castle can dictate terms and potentially kick clear when it matters. This tactical setup clearly favours the prominent racers and the lone front-runner, as they can position ideally without early pressure and have first run on the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Durham Castle Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Durham Castle gets an uncontested lead and maintains his recent winning form.
scenarios.body: The class horse dictates a steady pace then accelerates when ready, with the prominent trackers unable to match his finishing kick. His 92 rating and proven 6f ability on good ground makes him hard to peg back when in front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners gang up on Durham Castle in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Uncle Don, Shiplake and Diligently can all travel well in behind the leader then collectively swamp him late. Their similar ratings (88-90) and tactical positioning gives them every chance in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong and sets up a late closer.
scenarios.body: Another Abbot has shown his best form recently with three wins from his last five starts and excels when getting a strong pace to aim at. The Haggas runner can quicken late if the race unfolds to suit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders underperform and an improving sort capitalizes.
scenarios.body: Toolatetonegotiate arrives in career-best form with four wins from six starts and drops to a favorable mark. The unexposed four-year-old could exploit any tactical lapses from the fancied runners.

watchPoints.text: Durham Castle must prove his fitness after 79 days off, as any rustiness could be fatal given his front-running style
Another Abbot needs a strong enough pace to set up his late kick, as a steady gallop will favor the prominent runners
Watch for Uncle Don to be positioned prominently by apprentice Jack Callan, as any tactical errors could cost him
Righthere Rightnow requires monitoring after 101 days off, particularly how quickly Saffie Osborne can get him into the race
The prominent pack of Shiplake, Diligently and Alpha Magic could dictate the race if they collectively pressure Durham Castle early

races.paceDynamic: Solar Invincible stands alone as the only confirmed front-runner, meaning he can dictate terms uncontested from the gates with Bella Delizia the only other horse capable of tracking close. This creates a scenario where the pace-setter won't face early pressure, allowing for sustainable fractions that may not tire. With nine hold-up horses including the class acts Sea Her Excel, Little Jaybee and Hallandale Beach, there will be significant traffic problems in the straight as runners fan wide searching for racing room. The race shape clearly favours the front two - Solar Invincible and Bella Delizia - who can avoid the inevitable scrimmaging behind and control their own destiny.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Two Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Solar Invincible and Bella Delizia get away cleanly and maintain sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows them to save energy for a strong finish while the hold-up brigade get caught in traffic behind. Solar Invincible's recent win over course and distance when leading gives him the edge in this tactical battle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Powers Through
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses to a crawl and racing room opens up in the straight
scenarios.body: The premium hold-up performers can unleash their finishing kicks with Sea Her Excel's recent form spike and Hallandale Beach's class coming to the fore. This requires perfect timing from their experienced jockeys to find the gaps.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches and multiple hold-up horses get hampered in running
scenarios.body: A horse drawn away from trouble or one that can switch early gets first run on the leaders while others are still hunting for room. Rosieisme Darling's recent consistency could see her benefit from a cleaner passage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Solar Invincible Folds Under Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Solar Invincible gets headed turning for home and doesn't respond
scenarios.body: His recent efforts suggest vulnerability when challenged, and if Bella Delizia or an early challenger puts him under pressure, the door opens for the closers. This requires the pace to be strong enough to set up the finish.

watchPoints.text: Solar Invincible must break cleanly and establish position early - any hesitation allows Bella Delizia to potentially lead
The hold-up brigade bunching turning for home could create significant interference with nine horses needing racing room
Sea Her Excel's recent course form makes her dangerous if getting clear run, watch Sean Bowen's positioning moves
Little Jaybee's tendency to fade in finish means he needs to be closer than usual turning for home to be competitive
Bella Delizia returning after 56-day break may need the run despite Tom Marquand's booking suggesting readiness

races.paceDynamic: Alasrae will lead from the gate with Riley Rocks, Born Slippy, Got The Booty and Hayynah all positioned prominently behind. This creates a steady tempo rather than breakneck pace, as no other confirmed front-runners will challenge Alasrae's lead aggressively. The midfield and hold-up horses including Calling A Star, Our Guy, Shahik, Echo Of Faith and Akabusi will track the leaders through moderate fractions. This moderate pace scenario strongly favours prominent runners who can strike from close range, as the leaders won't collapse from unsustainable early fractions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Alasrae sets steady fractions without serious pressure through the first half
scenarios.body: The prominent group led by Riley Rocks, Marcellinus and Hayynah will be perfectly positioned to strike in the final furlong as they won't face collapsed leaders. Those tracking closest behind the lone leader gain the crucial tactical advantage over hold-up horses forced to make up significant ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens more than expected with multiple prominent runners pressuring Alasrae
scenarios.body: This creates the collapse scenario that suits the closers perfectly, with Our Guy, Calling A Star and Echo Of Faith sweeping past tired leaders. The additional pace will set up their preferred finishing kick from off the tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Alasrae gets completely uncontested fractions and builds an unassailable lead
scenarios.body: The class horse Alasrae simply proves too strong when getting his own way in front, kicking clear when the prominent runners make their move. Born Slippy could also benefit from this scenario given his early speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Meltdown Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the going deteriorates or multiple pace angles collapse simultaneously
scenarios.body: A completely messy race where tactical positioning breaks down entirely, favouring horses with the most natural ability regardless of running style. This unpredictable scenario could throw up a surprise result from the field.

races.paceDynamic: Court Of Stars and Espona Bay will contest the early lead, with Court Of Stars likely to dominate given their prominent style and recent front-running form. The pace should be sustainable rather than frantic with only two genuine pace-setters in an 11-runner field. Eight horses adopt hold-up tactics, creating a bunched field tracking the leaders through steady fractions. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those capable of tracking the pace, as the large hold-up contingent will face traffic problems in the straight when trying to make their moves simultaneously.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace holds strong
scenarios.trigger: If Court Of Stars or Espona Bay maintain their position without folding
scenarios.body: The early leaders get soft fractions and kick clear when the hold-up brigade gets shuffled back. Prominent runners who can track the pace without getting trapped behind the wall of hold-up horses will be perfectly positioned.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up cavalry charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses in the final furlong under pressure
scenarios.body: The large group of hold-up horses gets a clear run as the leaders tire, with the strongest finishers able to pick them off. Fresh legs and tactical speed will prove decisive in a bunch finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical speed prevails
scenarios.trigger: If traffic problems split the field in the straight
scenarios.body: Horses with the best tactical positioning and jockeys able to find gaps will capitalize while others get stopped in their run. Mid-division runners who avoid the scrimmaging will have clean runs to the line.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise from rear
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses and leaders stop
scenarios.body: A hold-up horse with a strong late kick catches a completely exhausted field that went too hard early. The winner emerges from the pack with a sustained run that others cannot match.
